subject: general
question: Identify the central theme of the passage.

options.text: Media and voice of the voiceless

solution:
The correct answer is: **'****Media and voice of the voiceless**'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The passage tell us about the social media as an voice of voiceless. Social media means interaction between individuals in which they generate, communicate and transfer thoughts and knowledge. People who were unheard are now able to access information and have a voice because of the magnificent advancements in communication systems. Social media allows people to be more aware of world issues, be open about their struggles and express their opinions. They can give their opinion on the issues they see around them, and they have an audience.
 
• We can easily identify that the idea that the passage wants to deliver is the **Media and voice of the voiceless.**
 
• The rest of the themes are contextually incorrect.

Therefore, the correct answer is**: *Media and voice of the voiceless***
